translations.web: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
translations.bsb: The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
translations.kjv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
translations.asv: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
